test.fill_query: INSERT INTO promql_one_side_ts (metric_name, tags, samples) SELECT 'cpu_seconds', map('instance', toString(intDiv(number, 32)), 'cpu', toString(intDiv(number, 4) % 8), 'mode', toString(number % 4)), arrayMap(step -> (toDateTime64(1000000 + step * 15, 3), toFloat64(step * (number % 7 + 1))), range(240)) FROM numbers_mt(8000)
test.query: SELECT * FROM prometheusQueryRange('promql_one_side_ts', 'rate(cpu_seconds{{instance="1", mode="0"}}[5m]) / ignoring(mode) group_left sum without (mode) (rate(cpu_seconds[5m]))', 1000300, 1003585, 15) FORMAT Null
